Reasoning: This stage keeps the panda_fingertip pose fixed while completing the grasp. freeze_position holds the current world-frame origin position within the required 0.01 m tolerance. freeze_orientation holds the current world-frame orientation and uses 5 degrees converted to radians, without adding any new tool +z or +y pointing/alignment objective. object_grasped is used instead of close_gripper because the stage requires a real grasp of the marker, not merely mechanically closed fingers; the gripper_closed condition records the intended closing state while the op requires actual grasp success. Symmetric left/right finger joint decrease, direct finger effort thresholds, detailed joint/effort feedback monitoring, and explicit abort logic are not representable with the available constraint ops; the fixed-pose thresholds represent the pose-deviation limit.
